cheatsheet.title: D-11 — Course tree renders in SWT Tree (desktop)

intro.description: Validates the course tree panel in the RCP desktop product. Requires -Dggbplus.course=path to be set. Checks tree rendering, step execution, validation feedback, and error handling. Gate: none (feature scenario). Status: NOT RUN (code not yet implemented).

item.title: 1. Prerequisites
item.description: Scenario type: UI / product-runtime. Client scope: desktop. Confirm applicable prerequisites before starting.

subitem.label: RCP image with course tree code (Codex WP2-06) is built and installed.

item.title: 2. Launch with course file
item.description: launch.ps1 -Course courses/trigonometry_intro.json. Shell opens with three-pane layout (tree | 2D | 3D).

subitem.label: Window appears with SWT Tree panel on the left.
GeoGebra 2D and 3D panels visible on the right.

item.title: 3. Tree rendering
item.description: Course title visible in tree panel header. 5 chapters visible with expand/collapse. Steps visible under each chapter.

item.title: 4. Step execution
item.description: Select step 1.1 (Create the origin), click Run. Point O appears at the origin in the 2D view.

subitem.label: Status bar shows success after step 1.1.
Select step 1.2, click Run: unit circle drawn.
No UI freeze during execution (threading contract).

item.title: 5. Validation (Check button)
item.description: After step 1.1, click Check: 'O exists' passes. After step 3.3, Check: CAS Pythagorean identity returns '1'.

subitem.label: Check icon changes to green checkmark on pass.
Check icon changes to red cross on fail.

item.title: 6. Error handling
item.description: Error dialogs suppressed during step execution (setErrorDialogsActive contract). Timeout after 10s shown in status bar. Button re-enables after error.

subitem.label: No GeoGebra modal error dialog appears during step execution.
Status bar shows timeout message if step exceeds 10s.

item.title: 7. Record evidence
item.description: Record date, commit, OS, Java version, image, command, expected vs actual, log path. Update SCENARIOS_TRACKING.

subitem.label: Evidence follows the AGENTS.md evidence rule.
